paired_scope: Four primary complex references minus ordinary EB; 2000 paired resamples of 11 years, fixed predictions; pointwise intervals without multiplicity adjustment or development refitting.
units: Metrics and paired CSV losses are original units. S34 multiplies differences and endpoints by 1000. Signed mean probability difference is predicted minus observed, in percentage points.
support_scope: Two primary EBL families; report counts with any environmental value outside a univariate training range or central percentile range. Unseen and pooled category fields count cells, not reports. Zero unseen cells can coexist with pooled categories.
